78238.synopsis:
The eldest son of a landlord’s family in the Lijia Village died in battle on the battlefield ten years ago, with no remains left behind.
Ten years later, Li Qingliu entered into a ghost marriage with him, prepared to live as a widow for the rest of her life.
Three months after their marriage, her husband, who was thought to have died in battle, returned.

78494.synopsis:
A trainee priestess under the protection of the princess.
An orphan abandoned in a mysterious forest. 
And… 
Frea, who sees other people’s emotions in colors. 
Positive emotions appear as golden hues, while negative emotions manifest as black. 
Her mysterious ability remained a secret known only to her. 
During her pilgrimage to become a priestess, Frea woke up in a strange man’s bed.
“Who… are you?”
The man, Aran, glared at her with glowing red eyes, his tone threatening. 
Aran looked exactly like the hero in the mural she had seen and admired since she was a child, even sharing the same name.
However, she couldn’t see the colors of his emotions. 
At first, she thought it was just a dream, that she had been having strange dreams repeatedly. 
But now… it doesn’t feel like a dream anymore. 
Who is this man? 
And why does she keep going to him in her dreams?
Why does it seem to be about “her”?

79262.synopsis:
Jiang Jin traveled through time in a novel and became the evil biological mother of four villain bosses. She was not a stepmother, but worse than a stepmother.
Boss: I don’t have a mother, my mother is dead!
The second child: Don’t touch me, I jumped out of the cracks in the rocks!
The third child: Drown or be killed, it’s your choice.
Fourth child: It’s best to die outside. I can reluctantly help you collect the body.
In order to save her four sons, she embarked on a road of battle of wits and courage with the four bastards.
Li Yunting: I don’t want my disobedient sons anymore, let’s have another one.
Four children: If we have another sister, we will definitely change our ways and start a new life!
associated_names: 四个反派崽子扑在我怀里撒娇

80286.synopsis:
In the heart of a volcano lies a mystical Mechanized Palace, a relic left behind by ancient sages, patiently awaiting its successor. In a desperate bid for its treasure, a mother sacrificed her life to claim the palace’s sacred seal, entrusting it to her son, Ning Zhuo, in her final moments.
This is no ordinary artifact; it is the Buddha-Heart Devil Seal.
It holds a profound truth: to enlighten oneself is to become a Buddha, yet to guide others may turn one into a devil. By wielding this seal, one can etch spiritual marks and command intricate mechanisms with ease, bearing only the lightest burden. While others strain under the immense mental weight of controlling even a few of such devices, Ning Zhuo effortlessly commands thousands with a single thought.
“Mother, I will honor your wish,” vowed Ning Zhuo. “I will claim the Mechanized Palace!”
Thus begins his journey:
A tale of spiritual bonds and ingenious marvels,
Where craftsmanship reveals cosmic truths,
And innovation opens realms of possibility.
An ancient bell resonates with eternal laws,
Its chime dancing under the moon’s serene glow.
With a form embodying infinite potential,
Who on earth could stand as his equal?

81054.synopsis:
With one eye shut and one eye open, he seems to be officially demented.
He remembers not his name, but has a vague recollection of the buddy he made a living with — a miraculous left eye.
Just by looking at a corpse, the eye could determine its cause of death and its killer (if one exists, that is).
Great, he can become “Holmes 2.0”, “Poirot’s Godson”, or “Conan’s Brother”…… He might as well visit the police station and take the civil service exam.
But who would have thought the world to change so fast, in the blink of an eye, mu*der was no longer a crime.
The “law” had long since departed the world once upon a Halloween over five hundred years ago. The future generation referred to that day as “End of the World”.
Of course, humans are always exaggerating. The world was fine, there was no destruction, all that’s destroyed was just the society of mankind.
Loud singing befits the dark alley.
Revelry belongs in the depth of hell.
Amidst the vast wilderness, must exist a Kindler.
When all have settled to dust, I will be the King of the world.
————–
Prologue of the “Song of the Exile” serialization

81310.synopsis:
The pride of Kunyun City, Wu Shaoqian, had been crippled! Not only had he fallen from the clouds to the mud overnight, but his soul had also been dispersing, on the verge of death.
Feeling embarrassed by his disability and wanting to save face, the Wu family had forced the Zhong family to marry off their daughter, bringing with her a life-saving treasure—the Guhun (Soul-Stabilizing) Fruit.
The Zhong family deliberated overnight. All three of their eligible daughters were unwilling, and if it was not done willingly, the Guhun Fruit would be useless. If Wu Shaoqian died, the Zhong family would surely be implicated.
Zhong Cai, the legitimate son of the Zhong family, had stepped forward: “I will go.”
As all legitimate descendants had the Guhun Fruit, everyone was overjoyed for a while.
—
Eighteen years after he transmigrated, Zhong Cai’s iron buddy, who had been secretly supporting him, was suddenly about to die. He glanced at his domineering cousins, afraid that if they married him and had a moment of resentment, his buddy would be gone.
So, he came up with a good idea.
Anyway, the Wu family was only marrying for the fruit, so it didn’t matter who married him. He would do it himself!
Wu Shaoqian had become useless, instantly abandoned by his family and relatives, unable even to decide on his marriage. He had no intention of implicating others and had decided that once the storm had passed in a few years, he would release the Zhong family girl. However—
On the night of their wedding, as they entered the bridal chamber, his best friend couldn’t wait to lift the veil, his face beaming as he pushed Wu Shaoqian down.
Zhong Cai: “Old Wu! Hurry, I’m here to save you~~”
Wu Shaoqian: “…” This is too much!
[Author’s notes]
From start to finish, it’s a one-on-one relationship, marriage before love, no tragedies. They both will give each other their best, even if they haven’t fallen in love yet. After falling in love, they will be very affectionate and romantic toward each other.
Semi-upgrade flow, fantasy background, a world with a harsh atmosphere, survival of the fittest type. Always remember strength is paramount, everything else is illusory. Don’t apply common ancient backgrounds here.
Transmigrated novel, with the original protagonist being Wu Dongxiao. The original book belongs to the male-oriented harem genre, and it may depict some related plotlines, so please don’t extrapolate to reality.

85150.synopsis:
In a world where reality and game seemed to have merged, with countless Monsters running rampant, with various Secret Realms and Dungeon Instances, one needed to be strong.
Strong enough to withstand the onslaught of these Monsters!
To do that, each person must go through Profession Changes and madly Level Up!
On the day of his Profession Change, Lu Fan had obtained the Hidden Profession, Dragon Tamer. However, this Profession was deemed the most useless since the Dragon Tamer would need a Giant Dragon to show its true prowess.
What were Giant Dragons? They were deity level existences. Taming them was impossible, thus Dragon Tamer rightfully earned the title of the most useless Profession. Fortunately, Lu Fan was not normal. He was a transmigrator who had awakened a System, the Super Treasure Map System!
With his Giant Dragon accompanying him, Lu Fan could sweep through everything, causing the entire world to tremble.
associated_names: I Got the Weakest Class, Dragon Tamer!?
National Career Change: Dragon Master Is The Weakest Occupation?
Universal Job Change: Is Dragon Tamer the Weakest Profession?
全民转职：驭龙师是最弱职业

88734.synopsis:
Seo Woohyun has been dreaming of the same man for several months now. 
Captivated by the man’s beautiful face, Seo Woohyun finds himself dreaming of this man repeatedly. 
For the first time, he realizes that he can actually communicate with him in these dreams. 
However, the man, who introduces himself as Erdian, casually brings up Seo Woohyun’s death.
[Cause of death: overwork. 
The autopsy report will list the cause of death as unknown. 
Unfortunately, without any surviving family members, there will be no request for an autopsy, nor a claim for work-related compensation. 
There are no signs of a break-in or foul play, and CCTV footage shows you buying beer at a convenience store before returning home. So, you’re set to be cremated just like that.] 
“What the hell kind of crazy dream is this after a night of drinking…?”
Thinking that everything would be fine once he woke up, Seo Woohyun opens his eyes, only to find himself on a ceremonial altar with colorful petals swirling around.
“The saint has awakened!”
“It’s Erdian!”
“Oh! The saint!”
Unexpectedly, Seo Woohyun has become the saint of the main god Erdian in another dimension. 
Erdian refuses to explain why he brought him here, only stating that he cannot return to his previous world.
Realizing he can’t live his entire life in denial, Seo Woohyun decides to embark on his first unofficial journey. 
Before he knows it, more people start joining his group one by one…
“Brother! Is this what you were talking about? I stole it from my mom’s storage!”
Malrang, a hatchling, steals things from the Dragon’s Keep that Seo Woohyun has been desperately missing from modern society.
“Here, let me carry this for you. It must be heavy. You’re not planning on leaving me behind, are you?”
A thief who aimed to rob their carriage but ended up as a porter without fear.
“…Ahem, it is permissible for the saint to call me by my given name, if you so wish.”
Even a bullied prince, who faces assassination attempts daily.
Before he knows it, not only does he have a bunch of annoying companions…
“Why do you keep distancing yourself from me lately? I’m openly upset.”
He even has to deal with a jealous god who grumbles about losing his one and only saint, leaving little time for the saint to heal. 
What are the 7 Transmigration Tips that the Saint has established?
associated_names: 7 советов по переселению душ от святого

88990.synopsis:
After the appearance of gates and monsters in the world, people’s lives were divided into two paths:
Those who live safely in protected zones and those who scr*pe by day by day in unprotected areas.
And
“Go ahead and die tomorrow if you must; today isn’t your day.”
 “What makes you think you have the right to say that?”
 “Who do you think you are to meddle?”
At the end of unbearable trials, a man appears before Yeo-Woon, who is on the verge of giving up on life.
Was it always his fate to end up like this? Or is it because he met that man, Moon Beom?
[Name: Yeo-Woon
Occupation: Healer 
Class: B 
Health: 28% 
Mana: 75% 
Combat Power: 32% 
Agility: 17% 
Main Skill: Nightingale’s Hand (B)
Other Skills: Seer’s Intuition (N)]

90014.synopsis:
“The strongest mercenary that couldn’t retire has started working.
‘You’re the daughter of the MH Group chairman?’
The mercenary Baek Shin-woo, who returned to the past, confronts his estranged mother.
The true identity of his mother, whom he had been indifferent to, and the fact that those connected to his death are targeting her…
The war has already begun. ‘Ah, damn it! This hellish subway!'”
associated_names: The Ex-Mercenary is a Conglomerate Heir

91294.synopsis:
Zhu Xiao’s arch-enemy, Wu Jiu, suddenly died unexpectedly. Zhu Xiao attended the funeral. At the funeral, he was informed that Wu Jiu had left him a massive inheritance.
But there was one condition: he had to visit Wu Jiu’s grave every week.
Zhu Xiao agreed.
•
Zhu Xiao always had a feeling that Wu Jiu wasn’t really dead.
So, he made it a point to do outrageous things, including but not limited to dancing at Wu Jiu’s grave and eating fried chicken, deliberately trying to provoke the dead, as if to make even a corpse flip the coffin lid in anger.
Until one day, his phone forcefully downloaded an app called “Yin-Yang Communication,” and an anonymous contact messaged him.
【You’re something else, eating like a pig at my grave.】
Zhu Xiao sent a question mark back and replied:【Who are you?】
Then added:【What’s up?】
【Wu Jiu.】
After a lot of typing and deleting, Wu Jiu awkwardly got to the point:【Burn me a picture of you.】
•
One day, Zhu Xiao consulted a lawyer about how to handle Wu Jiu’s massive inheritance.
His phone started vibrating like crazy.
When he opened it, he saw a flood of notifications from the “Yin-Yang Communication” app.
【? Who’s that guy next to you?】
【Why are you smiling at him?】
【You even brought him to my grave?】
【Seriously, I’m about to come back to life just because of you!】
The next day, as soon as Zhu Xiao stepped outside, he saw his long-dead rival squatting like a mushroom at his doorstep, with green smoke rising from his head, staring at him with a face full of resentment.
Zhu Xiao: “…”
This was unbelievable!!!
associated_names: Bringing My Rival Back to Life (Accidentally)
给死对头上坟却把他气活了

97182.synopsis:
Even on the bed, she’s a panther.
That’s Astrid for you.

97694.synopsis:
Gu Xicao transmigrated into a penniless orphan who illegally smuggled herself into Hong Kong during the 1990s.
She has no money and is about to be kicked out, her only cheat is the Gossip System!
Gu Xicao: “Don’t panic—watch me pull off a little trick.”
In the extravagant and booming 1990s Hong Kong, where feng shui and fortune-telling runs deep across all classes, from humble workers to high-ranking officials, Gu Xicao made her grand entrance. She doesn’t need to divine fortunes or analyze faces—just give her a name, and she can see through your past, present, and future.
“Miss Zhou, you lost your father as a child, your husband in middle age, and your son in old age. This is not a life of loneliness; it means you are destined for great success. The wise don’t fall into the trap of love—focus on building a better China.”
Ms. Zhou, who had returned from studying abroad, was enlightened. She abandoned emotional entanglements, worked hard on her career, and rose as a shining star in the business world.
“Mr. Wu, the bad news is your wife and your close friend are plotting against you—even trying to take your life. The good news is your ex-wife and daughter still care for you.”
The big boss in the legal circle turned pale, immediately filed for divorce, and rushed to reconcile with his ex-wife, offering hundreds of millions in assets, leaving everyone in Hong Kong stunned.
A serial killer terrorized the city, leaving citizens too afraid to go out at night.
The police headquarters issued a strict deadline: the killer must be caught within three days.
Yet Inspector Lin apprehended the criminal the very next morning. Facing reporters, he said: “Catching the killer was all thanks to Master Gu’s accurate calculations!”
In an instant, Gu Xicao’s reputation soared, making her the top fortune-teller in Hong Kong.
Countless newspapers featured her achievements, and high-ranking officials and the wealthy scrambled to get her contact information.
Gu Xicao: “At first, I just wanted to make enough for the rent.”
associated_names: 我靠吃瓜系統裝神棍[九零]

97950.synopsis:
Qiao Chuchu, after being brought back to a wealthy family, is bound to a gossip system and learns that the world she lives in is actually a book.
She and her top-tier brother, Qiao Cen, are both cannon fodder meant to promote the romance between the male and female leads, and the tragedy begins with a variety show that Qiao Cen is about to participate in.
Qiao Chuchu: I’m done for, my luxurious life is just beginning!
—
After the guest list for ‘Dear Us’ was announced, the combination of Qiao Cen and his sister Qiao Chuchu sparked a storm of public opinion online.
Qiao Chuchu has no time to pay attention, too busy enjoying the gossip.
【Wait, the top-tier celebrity is marrying his childhood sweetheart, yet still maintaining a single persona?】  
【His childhood sweetheart was replaced by someone else before returning to the country, and the replacement is a man.】  
【What’s even more outrageous is that this man, using his top-tier identity, is scamming women, deceiving them for money and s*x, and even keeping a mistress.】
Qiao Chuchu: Why is the top-tier celebrity storming off angrily? And then suddenly kneeling down to thank me for sending him resources?
A pure goddess debuting as a small celebrity on the variety show shocks Qiao Chuchu.
【This female lead isn’t a pure, innocent flower, she keeps eight fish. Is she some kind of sea king?】  
【Let me see who else is here – a silly rich CEO, a singer in pink underwear, an honest director…】  
【She’s scouting for little fish on the show, and silly brother Qiao Cen has become her top target. How do I convince my naïve brother to stay away from her?】
Qiao Cen, happily eating up the gossip: Me? The silly, naive brother?
Qiao Chuchu: Why is the variety show suddenly paused? Oh, it turns out the director is also one of the female lead’s fish.
On a whim, Qiao Chuchu visits her brother’s film set.
【The male lead is no doubt an award-winning actor, loves to wear women’s clothes, and even pretends to be a girl online to flirt with guys.】  
【He’s flirted with quite a few: a CEO, a muscular guy, a married director… they even met up!】  
【Too bad he doesn’t know that, next time they meet, the other party is a serial killer, and he’ll be killed… and…】
Qiao Chuchu: Am I still not done with my gossip? Why did the award-winning actor suddenly collapse?
—
Later, everyone in the entertainment industry and the wealthy circles showered Qiao Chuchu with resources, money, and begged to be her friend.
Eventually, netizens cried out, begging Qiao Chuchu to debut and asking the Qiao siblings to appear on variety shows.
Qiao Chuchu successfully changed her fate, and her brother became a top celebrity with overwhelming popularity.
Qiao Cen, however, wasn’t as thrilled, as he had been too busy with work and hadn’t been keeping up with the gossip with his sister.
One day, after finishing his schedule, he flew back to spend his sister’s birthday with her, only to find her standing next to his good brother.
Qiao Chuchu: How do I tell my brother about my relationship?
Qiao Cen: With who?!
associated_names: 女配心声泄露后成团宠

99230.synopsis:
Her husband has died.
It was a sudden death, caused by a chronic illness.
The young lord, who had only recently married and had no children, left everyone on the estate in mourning.
But they were only pretending to grieve.
“He died of a heart attack while playing with prostit**es.”
“Isn’t it all because the Grand Duchess failed to fulfil her duties as his legitimate wife?”
Elliope suffered in silence under the weight of the terrible truth.
“You are not what I wanted, Princess.”
Elliope’s husband, who had always humiliated and belittled her, claiming he had been tricked into a fraudulent marriage, died in the arms of other women.
With few options left, Elliope made her choice.
She would rather face death than return to the palace and be sold to another man.
But then came an unexpected turn of events.
“Your Highness, the Grand Duchess.”
The man she had met in her last moments, desperately clinging to his brief kindness, unexpectedly reappeared in her life after being transported three years into the past.
In a moment of impulsive courage, Elliope whispered:
“Take my v*rginity, Kallian Icerick.”
The man who had always looked at her with cold, contemptuous eyes now looked at her with a spark of fire in his expression.
“From this moment on, you are my wife, Elliope Kartan.”
associated_names: Captured by My Husband’s Loyal Dog

99742.synopsis:
During the summer vacation of his first year in high school, Shirayanagi Minato found himself in a bind—completely out of cash. Desperate for a solution, he turned to his mother, and with a knowing smile, she introduced him to an unusual job. It was a one-time household support service, something Minato, with his talent for housework, was confident he could handle.
But when he arrived at his assignment, he was greeted by a shocking revelation: the client was Fujisaki Kanon, the cool, enigmatic beauty from his class, adored by many but known to few. And the sight that awaited him? Her chaotic, disaster of a room—an overwhelming mess that stood in stark contrast to her composed demeanor.
Caught off guard by Kanon’s unexpected vulnerability, Minato pushed through his surprise and got to work. He cleaned every corner of her messy home until it sparkled and even prepared a warm, homemade dinner for her. The grateful yet reserved Kanon watched silently, her cool exterior betraying hints of embarrassment.
The job was supposed to be a one-time deal. Yet, just when Minato thought their interaction would end there, Kanon reached out to him again, asking—no, pleading—for him to continue helping her.
Day by day, as Minato took care of her, something shifted between them. Kanon, who had always kept others at arm’s length, began to lower her walls. Slowly but surely, she started to let him into her life.
“Hey, Minato-kun… what’s for dinner tonight?” she asked one evening, her voice softer than usual, tinged with a mix of curiosity and comfort.
Before either of them realized it, relying on Minato had become second nature to her. The once-cool and untouchable Kanon now found herself looking forward to his presence, her heart quietly warming to the boy who had transformed her chaotic life into something a little brighter.
associated_names: After I Became the Housekeeper for the Cool Beauty in My Class, She Started Asking Me What’s for Dinner Every Day
クラスのクール美少女の家事代行をしたら、毎日晩御飯の献立を聞いてくるようになった

99998.synopsis:
If you could redo a failed life, would you love the same person again?
I am Masahito Arisugawa, a pianist and violinist.
My wife, Miyako, is a world-renowned violinist—a figure who, to me, was always beyond reach.
As a musician, I’m second-rate at best. Yet, I believed I had found my own version of happiness. At least, I thought so—until that day.
On the day I turned 41, my wife Miyako left, taking our only daughter with her.
There had always been someone Miyako admired from her student days—Sousuke Mikami.
When she found out that he had divorced, she couldn’t sit still. She took our daughter, Saki, and left to chase after him.
Realizing Miyako’s true feelings, I drowned myself in alcohol, despite not being able to handle strong drinks. Lost in despair, I succumbed to acute alcohol poisoning and blacked out.
I thought I had died, but when I awoke, I found myself as a 15-year-old again.
No, that’s not quite accurate—I hadn’t just returned to my younger self; I had time-slipped 25 years into the past.
In other words, I had time-leaped.
Before me stretched the world of my first year in high school.
At my newly entered school, there were familiar faces from long ago—and a youthful, fresh Miyako.
But in this world, I resolved not to get involved with her.
(I won’t let myself end up with Miyako. That’s the only thing I’ll change. Nothing else.)
I only wished to lead a peaceful life.
However, when I unconsciously saved the life of Sachiko Kazami, the flow of time around me—what should have been the same as 25 years ago—began to shift into something entirely different…
associated_names: おまえだけは選ばない

104350.synopsis:
A noble serves the kingdom, they don’t work for money. This was the absolute, unspoken rule of the aristocratic world. However, Jeanne de Toulouse, the eldest daughter of the venerable Toulouse count family, was different.
She’d worked as a tutor for young Master Mael, the son of His Majesty’s mistress, for two years. One day, books by Enlightenment thinkers, known for disrupting the order of the monarchy, were discovered in the young master’s study. And Jeanne was immediately accused of being the culprit.
“I’ve never even read that book! I’m hearing the title for the first time!”
Despite her claims of innocence, she was sentenced to exile. Her destination; the Duchy of Skadi, a land inhabited by barbarians, where the bitter wind blows.
Centuries ago, when barbarians from a frozen land across the sea invaded the capital city, the previous king granted this land as a fief, realizing their goal was simply to find habitable land. Now, the descendants of their chieftain held the title of Duke, recognized for their ancestors’ contributions to protecting the kingdom.
“We’ve arrived at the Duchy.”
After the arduous journey, Jeanne remembered nothing. All she recalled was the endless cycle of her whole body burning and freezing at the same time.
‘Even I’ve ended up like this…what if Mother falls ill from the shock?’
‘Wouldn’t it be better to just die here?’
At that moment, her spirit was as weak as her dying body.
After an unknown amount of time, a strange man’s voice, different from the ones she’d been hearing, echoed from above her head.
“Did they plan to blame the barbarians again if she died here after being tortured just enough to survive exile?”
The voice was surprisingly resolute and powerful, enough to momentarily hold onto her consciousness, which wavered like a dying candle, briefly brightening and fading again.
“So, she’s in this state simply from arriving here, without even being tortured? Even after the prince…lent his own steed? I’ll take charge of her now.”
With these words, laced with incomprehension, Jeanne’s body was suddenly lifted.
* * *
“Here, everyone works, regardless of age, gender, or social status. The land is vast and there’s a lot to do, but there aren’t many people. This applies to exiles who are occasionally sent from the capital as well.”
The Duke of Skadi’s words meant he was making good use of the labor of exiles, whether nobles or common criminals. But Jeanne was relieved.
“Then, when should I begin my work?”
“You’re quick to adapt to the situation. You said you were a tutor. What did you teach?”
“I taught foreign languages, humanities, logic, rhetoric, and arithmetic.”
However, his suspicious gaze remained. He abruptly spoke in a foreign language. Jeanne had assumed the Duke was skilled in killing people, not humanities. But his knowledge was extensive, and his words revealed sharp logic and thought.
“Let’s end this conversation here. I want you to become my child’s tutor.”
Typically, the lady of the house held the authority to hire nannies and tutors. As if reading her thoughts, the Duke of Skadi explained.
“I have no wife. The child you will teach is my adopted daughter and niece. She was originally my brother’s child, but he passed away, so I took on her upbringing. She turned thirteen this year. What do you think?”
Understanding the situation, Jeanne smiled brightly. There was something odd about the Duke’s words, but at least she wouldn’t die.
“Yes! I’ll do it! I’ll be the tutor!”

104606.synopsis:
Born and raised as the cherished daughter of a marquis’s household, Wei Hanzhang had no grand ambitions in life. She only dreamed of marrying her childhood sweetheart and living a happy life together.
Unexpectedly, before they could marry, her childhood sweetheart took two concubines!
Shocked, she then discovered she had transmigrated into a book.
Her mother was the villainous supporting character who lost in the household battles.
Her elder sister was the cannon fodder who was framed and lost her reputation at the beginning.
Her maternal family was a minor character family that was quickly destroyed in the original story.
And she…
She didn’t even exist in the original book!
Unacceptable!
How could she be a mere cannon fodder?
Since she was here and had received the grace of life, she had to protect her family.
If her childhood sweetheart was unreliable, the Prince next door seemed quite nice.
associated_names: 宠妾灭妻？ 这宅斗文炮灰我罩了

104862.synopsis:
[1] 
During the period when Yin Mengxi was betrayed by her career, she unexpectedly reencountered the failed romance from her school days.
The former Senior Xiao had now become Professor Xiao. The only thing that hadn’t changed was that he still quietly appeared in her camera lens—his hands, which had spent years turning the pages of books, were as elegant as ever, just like the pure heart she once harbored while secretly admiring him.
“Have you ever done anything in your life that you regret?”
She lowered her head and asked the question mechanically from her interview script.
The person across from her fell silent, as if lost in deep thought. After a moment, he replied, “Yes, I have.”
She raised an eyebrow. “What was it?”
“That semester, I shouldn’t have given a girl a C,” he said honestly, looking straight at her.
[2] 
She knew it well—this man’s eyes only held the brightness of sunlight after rain and the beauty of spring. He was never like her, chasing fame and fortune with greed and worldliness. Yet, when she fell, he reached out his hand to catch her. At that moment, his eyes carried the vastness of the sea under the rising moon, brimming with both expansiveness and tenderness.
If you’re tired, take a little nap.
My love,
Spring has already arrived.
[Story Guide] 
1. School + Workplace (primarily set in school). A self-unaware beauty who is a top performer in the workplace X A professor of ancient literature.
2. One-on-one relationship, slow burn, happy ending.

105886.synopsis:
The day a new commander arrived at the Imperial Red Knights.
On the day a new commander is appointed to the Imperial Red Knights, Jack Carlson, a commoner-born knight, detects something impossible—
the scent of an Omega’s pheromones inside the knights’ headquarters.
“…Why—why is there an Omega in a place like this?”
“Tch. Damn brat, you’re annoyingly sharp.”
The Omega standing before him has a foul mouth, but his face is so breathtakingly beautiful that Jack instinctively begins flirting with him—
or at least, trying his best to seduce him.
“Make it quick. As much as you can handle, as intensely as you can manage. Be a damn wild rabbit like there’s no tomorrow. Got it?”
“…”
“Why aren’t you answering? Can’t do it?”
“No, sir. I am confident…!”
Even though he is flustered by the domineering presence of this charismatic Omega, Jack impulsively dives into the situation headfirst.
But when it’s over, the Omega vanishes like the wind—
And the next time Jack sees him is on the stage at the commander’s inauguration ceremony.
…As the new Knight Commander.

107678.synopsis:
At twenty, studying abroad was Heeju’s escape.
Except for the moments she had to face him—Ryu Iseok.
Every two weeks, when she visited the Paris villa, he would sit there, silently watching her with a cigarette in hand. For an entire year, that bizarre ritual continued—until he vanished without a trace.
Then, at twenty-five, he reappeared. As her fiancé.
“I let you live however you wanted until twenty-five, didn’t I? Even if you ended up pregnant, I was prepared to take responsibility for that much.”
Muttering incomprehensible words.
“Why are you doing this to me?”
“Because it’s amusing. Like watching someone who’s just opened their eyes to the world.”
Ryu Iseok suffered from prosopagnosia—an inability to recognize faces due to the aftereffects of an accident. The rumors about his deteriorating sanity were endless, and the gossip surrounding him was nothing short of terrifying.
And yet, there was one face he could recognize.
Yeon Heeju’s.
“What should I do? I just want to breathe a little… by your side.”
But what he showed her wasn’t love. It was a possessiveness too overwhelming to bear.
Why did it have to be her?
She struggled to escape the inevitable, desperate to avoid marriage with him. But the more she resisted, the deeper she sank into the quicksand.
“I told you, you’re my light.”
Where would this fate lead them in the end?

109982.synopsis:
Duan Yi accidentally transmigrated to a parallel world, turning from an Alpha into an Omega, and even married his mortal enemy.
Three years passed with two children, life bitter yet happy. Just as Duan Yi accepted this reality…
He transmigrated back.
Sitting in his high school classroom, Duan Yi:
f*ck! When you send me back, at least remove the mark!
***
Synopsis 2:
Sheng Yunze felt Duan Yi was acting strange lately.
Clearly an Alpha, yet carrying his own pheromones.
And he secretly took advantage of him—stealing clothes and even calling him “husband”.
What’s wrong with this Alpha?
***
Synopsis 3:
Duan Yi realized his cursed life wasn’t over yet.
If he didn’t obtain Sheng Yunze’s pheromones soon, he’d die.
***
Warning: The Alpha is a venomous tongue, ice-cold.
AO story. The main character transmigrated back and became an Omega.
System involved, but not a traditional one.
Venomous, cold Alpha who likes to control x Optimistic Omega who gets beaten up but never gives up.
Micro-science fiction elements.

110750.synopsis:
Twice transmigrated, Liu A’dou, now reborn as Kaitou Kid, has no choice but to face a world full of superheroes.
But after spending a lifetime becoming the best phantom thief in the world of detectives, he doesn’t know if he can escape unscathed from under the noses of superheroes like Batman, Superman, and Spider-Man from DC and Marvel.
Or maybe… he should just team up with them and save the Earth now and then?

112030.synopsis:
Cheong-yeon demands a divorce from Do-heon, ending their three-year marriage.
“I think I’ve seen enough, both good and bad. Let’s end this. Please divorce me, Do-heon.”
And so Yoo Cheong-yeon adds “divorcee” to his list of titles alongside former failed idol and high school graduate. As he struggles to restart his acting career that he had given up due to Do-heon’s opposition, his ex-husband starts acting strangely.
‘Is it just my imagination, or does Do-heon, who never showed the slightest interest in me before, keep lingering around?’
Eventually, Do-heon even proposes a sponsorship arrangement to Cheong-yeon.
“Spon…sorship?” 
“Once a week. Meeting me every Friday evening.”
“Why should I accept sponsorship from you, Director?”
“Because I can get you cast in that drama. As the lead role, of course.”
Cheong-yeon wants to flatly refuse, telling him not to talk nonsense, but the wealthy ex-husband’s offer is too tempting.
‘But this guy didn’t even enjoy having s*x with me when we were together.’
Do-heon’s unpredictable attitude leaves Cheong-yeon confused.
“Fine. I’ll agree if there’s no physical contact. It’s not like you’re making this offer because you want to sleep with me anyway.”
“Why would you think I wouldn’t demand s*x from you?”
Cheong-yeon’s eyes widened at these unexpected words.
“What?”
“Even though we’re divorced now, we were legitimately married.”
“Then… that means…”
“Of course s*x is included. Isn’t that the basic condition of sponsorship?”

112798.synopsis:
Lan Wu is a mermaid demon princess who runs away from home to escape an arranged marriage. While fleeing, she is spotted by a cultivator who tries to kill her. In desperation, she swallows a pill that conceals her demonic aura, but as a side effect, it also sealed her demonic powers.
Ji Lingyue, an aspiring cultivator, happens to be passing through the mountains when she finds Lan Wu listlessly resting beneath a tree. After saving her, Lan Wu decides to accompany Ji Lingyue, and the two of them head to Haochen Mountain to become disciples.

113566.synopsis:
It is known throughout the Three Realms that the Divine Lord Zhuoqing and the Demon Emperor were once close friends. However, just before the great war between gods and demons, rumors spread that Zhuoqing personally slew the Demon Emperor, shocking all Three Realms.
A thousand years ago, Ye Qinming loved Zhuoqing deeply, but a thousand years later, her love turned into hatred. 
Only in the end did she realize that the person Zhuoqing had wronged the most was not her, but herself. 
Gu Xiyan: “Qinming, what kind of tea are you?”
Ye Qinming: “Your nose is so sharp, can’t you figure it out yourself?”
Gu Xiyan: “Black tea?”
Ye Qinming: “Brew it and you’ll know.”
From then on, they washed inkstones with tea and brewed tea with stream water.
(T/N: This sentence is a wordplay of the combination of their names. 溪砚 xīyàn meaning “stream” and “inkstone”, 沁茗 qìnmíng meaning “to brew” and “young leaves of tea”)
“Compassionate to all, yet loving you the most.”
This is a tale of past and present lives, featuring a blind yet perceptive white lotus god with a keen nose, a clever mind, and sharp ears, and a tsundere green tea demon emperor who talks tough but acts tender.
(T/N: “Appreciating tea with inkstone” refers to a leisure activity practiced by nobles in ancient times. It involves drinking tea while engaging in literary pursuits such as painting or composing poetry, which require the use of a brush and ink)

113822.synopsis:
Ji Yan one day becomes a “Chosen One” and is forcibly transported into a bizarre game world ruled by eerie, supernatural beings. In this world, humans are at the bottom of the food chain. To survive, players must complete various dungeon quests to obtain food and equipment.
Every player can awaken a “Trait Talent”, granting them strange and unique game privileges. However, Ji Yan seemingly draws the short end of the stick and awakens the lowest-tier, discarded talent.
But soon after, he discovers—
this terrifying game has just given him a bug-level talent at the very beginning…
associated_names: 诡异游戏：开局觉醒Bug级天赋

116894.synopsis:
My sanctuary is the laundromat late at night on weekends. There I met a young woman with bright pink hair who, for some reason, suddenly started speaking to me in a casual manner.
Later, the pink-haired woman turned up at a meeting with an IT venture company that I do business with.
associated_names: The beautiful kuudere girl who always reads in line at the laundromat turns out to be the vice president of a client company
コインランドリーでいつも並んで読書をしているクーデレ美少女が取引先の副社長だった

124574.synopsis:
In their first year of high school, Zhou Nianzhi was assigned to sit next to Song Yuli because she talked too much.
Everyone knew Song Yuli—beautiful, aloof, and cold as ice. She barely spoke to anyone.
But Zhou Nianzhi didn’t believe in unreachable people. There wasn’t a friend she couldn’t make.
So despite the frost and thorns, she approached Song Yuli step by step.
She was really good to Song Yuli.
So good, in fact, that even she couldn’t explain why.
At the time, all she wanted was to see her every day,
To give her the best things in the world.
But those were just childish promises.
At 22, after a night of heated ambiguity, she buttoned up Song Yuli’s shirt, hiding the marks of passion. Her voice was cold:
“Let’s not see each other again.”
…
At 16, Song Yuli had once seriously written in her prettiest notebook:
“Zhou Nianzhi is a noisy little bird, a roaring wind, and the sunlight I long for.”
Six years later, she crossed out the sentence, crumpled the paper, and tossed it into the tr*sh.
“Liar,” she whispered.
But fate, ever cruel and cyclical, led them back together.
And so, two years after their parting, upon seeing Zhou Nianzhi again,
Song Yuli’s smile curved like a hunter’s, her tone gentle yet terrifying:
“I finally found you again.”
“You can’t leave me anymore, Zhizhi.”

128158.synopsis:
The “Emperor’s Flame” is said to fall to the world once every hundred years.
Whoever gains that star will gain the world.Ryu Won (Cheong-gyeon-gun), the last prince of a fallen kingdom, meets Gunbam-i, a woman born holding a star, as if by fate.
When he learns her story, Ryu Won realizes that she is the child he saved nineteen years ago.Both of them survived. Just confirming that they are alive is enough.
Thinking of it as nothing more than a fleeting fate, he tries to distance himself…> “I don’t know what to call this feeling.
I’ve never experienced it before.”“……”“So, I will leave all of this nameless feeling… here.” At the moment he decides to accept the desire he has suppressed all his life, only one thought remains:> “I want you.
I don’t want to let you go.
… I want you to be mine.” In an age filled with war and chaos, where people kill one another just to survive,
Gunbam-i wants to become Ryu Won’s only star against those who seek the Emperor’s Flame,
and Ryu Won wants to protect his one and only star…

130718.synopsis:
Yu Zhiling transmigrated into the role of the villainous master in a xianxia novel, bound to a “Merit System.”
The male protagonist, Mo Zhu, possessed the bloodline of a snake demon and was oppressed and tormented by his villainous master, leading him to darken his path. After slaying the antagonist, he abandoned cultivation and descended into demonic ways, weakening the world’s fate and causing its collapse.
The system informed her: [Your mission is to prevent the male protagonist from falling into darkness. Guide him to cultivate diligently and ascend as soon as possible. Do not let him neglect his training—only then can his protagonist aura strengthen, and the Heavenly Dao will reward you with merit to keep you alive.] 
Yu Zhiling: “Got it. So, I just need to raise a righteous overachiever? No problem!”
The revered Immortal Master Yu Zhiling suddenly emerged from seclusion, and her first act was to summon the disciple she had sent to exterminate evil.
At the foot of the high platform, the young man knelt on the ground, his expression indifferent. “If Master wishes to punish me, do so quickly. This disciple still needs to return to exterminate evil.”
Yu Zhiling stared at his injuries, stammering, “I-I-I summoned you for another important matter.”
Mo Zhu lifted his gaze indifferently, only to see his usually cold and cruel master stand up—and then dump an entire library’s worth of sword manuals before him.
Mo Zhu: “?”
Yu Zhiling said earnestly, “Only by outworking the hardest workers can one rise above all. One manual a day, and in ten years, you’ll reach the Great Perfection of Tribulation Transcendence. Do you have the confidence?”
Mo Zhu: “…”
From then on, Immortal Master Yu Zhiling’s reputation spread once more—this time because, for some unknown reason, she had begun zealously pushing her disciple to cultivate.
While others ate, Mo Zhu practiced swordplay.
While others slept, Mo Zhu practiced swordplay.
While others woke, Mo Zhu was still practicing swordplay.
Meanwhile, Yu Zhiling crouched in the distance, dark circles under her eyes, hugging her knees as tears streamed down her face.
Onlookers marveled, “Though the Immortal Master is strict, she truly cares for her disciple—she’s even crying out of pity.”
Only Yu Zhiling could hear the mechanical voice chiming repeatedly:
[The male protagonist has mastered the Sword Sect’s secret technique. Host’s merit +100.] 
[The male protagonist has claimed the Sect’s Guardian Sword. Host’s merit +100.] 
[The male protagonist has reached the Great Perfection of Divine Transformation. Host’s merit +100.] 
Yu Zhiling sobbed, “He’s not just mastering sword techniques—he’s racking up my merit!”
By the time Mo Zhu reached the Tribulation Transcendence stage, Yu Zhiling, now with enough merit to ensure her survival, packed her bags and prepared to vanish into obscurity.
At the foot of the mountain, amidst the shadowy forest, the young man stood with sword in hand, his presence transcendent and pristine.
Mo Zhu lifted his gaze, smiling. “Master, this disciple has reached Tribulation Transcendence. May I claim a reward?”
Then, step by step, he closed the distance between them, his voice gentle as he murmured, “For example… you.”
Yu Zhiling’s bag dropped to the ground.
Mo Zhu curved his eyes into crescents, grinning as he asked, “Will you give yourself to me, Master?”
Mo Zhu was the last Teng snake in the world—cold by nature, his bones steeped in hatred, and every day, he dreamed of killing his master.
Later, he decided on a different way to “kill” her.
He dragged her into his cave, his serpentine tail coiling around her inch by inch. Retracting his fangs, he defied hierarchy, pressing fervent, worshipful kisses upon her.
He even carved out his reverse scale and gifted it to her, baring his vulnerable core before her—his life and death now hers to command.
[Fake Strictness · Real Sweetheart Master × Younger, Scheming, Obsessive Snake Boy] 
Reading Guide:
– The male protagonist may be cunning, but he’s an absolute simp!
– A sweet romance-focused story, 1V1, HE.
associated_names: 穿为男主的反派师尊后

136350.synopsis:
※ This work contains coercive relationships and themes that may be divisive. Reader discretion is advised.
I transmigrated into the protagonist of a dark, tragic novel.
I became Sylvia, beautiful and pitiful, taken as a hostage from a ruined country and locked away in a cold castle,
where she is violated by numerous men.
The male leads scorned and trampled her, sneering that she was the enemy of their families, a filthy heretic, a body lower than a s*ave.
They degraded her, violated her, and crushed her under force.
They say they hate me with their mouths, yet their bodies are so very honest.
Men really are incapable of being straightforward.
In the original story, Sylvia wanted nothing more than to escape the castle.
But me? I don’t have even an ant’s speck of intention to leave.
I mean… why should I?
When gorgeous men gift me with extreme pleasure every single night, isn’t this place heaven?
And so, while I was sinking deeper into my cozy life of confinement, one day a quest arrived.
[Escape from the castle!
Reward: Hidden dopamine-explosion event
Penalty: Death] 
…Ah.
Well then. I guess I have no choice. Time to run.
associated_names: 볼모가 된 공주인데, 감금이 너무 아늑하다

140702.synopsis:
It seems that my stepsister, not me, is actually the true saint.
Because they said I bullied her, my engagement with the prince was broken off, and I was sent to work at the dormitory of the First Knight Order, which protects the remote region overrun by monsters.
…And honestly, how wonderful!
I’ve never told anyone this before, but I absolutely love strong, muscular knights!
The prince was so skinny and not attractive at all, and my stepmother treated me terribly, so I have no regrets about leaving.
So yes, I’ll gladly go to the frontier! To the knights’ dormitory!
The food here is delicious, the knights are kind, cool, and amazing—I’m so happy.
But it’s strange. Ever since I came, the monsters have become quieter, and everyone seems to feel better after eating my cooking.
…Revenge? No need for that.
Because right now, I’m perfectly happy!
A romantic comedy about a cheerful, kindhearted saint who loves knights but doesn’t notice the knight commander’s affection, and the commander who, while misunderstanding her, devotedly loves her all the same.
associated_names: Tsuihou Sareta Kishizuki Seijo wa Kyou mo Shiawase
追放された騎士好き聖女は今日も幸せ

150942.synopsis:
He Jingsu watched the people fawning over the little fluffy bird and felt an instinctual displeasure.
The little fluffy bird was clearly hers. What right did they have to covet her little bird?
She could treat the little bird better than any of them!
—
As a Northern Long-tailed Tit, Bei Queting was supposed to huddle with other ti*s for warmth, but she was ostracized. She learned to be cautious from a young age. After being driven out of her flock’s territory, she met a very cute girl.
The girl’s true form was a panda cub with a pair of wings. She was incredibly good to her, letting her run wild.
And she meant that literally—running wild on top of her head.
As Bei Queting nestled on the panda’s head, she thought, I want to be with He Jingsu forever.
Coincidentally, that was exactly what He Jingsu was thinking, too.
A naturally dazed, doting panda with a strong desire to pamper her wife (Gong/Top) x A little fluffy bird who is soft on the outside, strong on the inside, and incredibly possessive (Shou/Bottom).
A sweet, heartwarming story about the daily lives of childhood sweethearts.
Tags: Flower Season and Rainy Season (Youth), Childhood Sweethearts, Sweet Story, Cute Pets, Relaxing

172446.synopsis:
In stories, there are always those empty-headed, scummy female leads and vicious female supporting characters who have a great hand of cards but play them terribly.
By their side is a deeply devoted and loyal supporting male character, yet they discard him like an old shoe.
It makes the readers furious.
But society teaches you how to be a decent person. When the scummy female leads in these stories endure endless trials, suddenly wake up to reality, and return to the crossroads of their life choices, a new story begins~
associated_names: 渣女每天都在堅強自救

181406.synopsis:
Orlando Dale Fort, a sixteen-year-old genius hunter who created the “Dragon-Slaying Rifle,” is the ace of the Royal Dragon-Slaying Squad.
During a mission to subjugate the Silver Dragon Queen he is betrayed by his own teammates. One of them is even his girlfriend of two years.
Just as he thinks he is about to die there…
the Silver Dragon Queen does not kill him.
associated_names: 遭队友背叛的屠龙天才成了银龙姬

181662.synopsis:
The female lead is a magnet for admirers, with multiple male leads set against a Korean background, chaebol families, and a pull-and-tug dynamic.
There are older men, younger men, mature ones, cunning ones, gentle ones, and explosive ones.
Song Eunni is the youngest daughter of the SKB Communications Group, a Korean chaebol family. But she was switched at birth, ending up raised in Busan with a thick Busan accent, a 180-pound frame, coarse dark skin, small eyes, and a flat nose.
At eighteen, the SKB family discovered through a physical examination that their daughter was not biologically theirs. After an extensive search, they found the female lead, who had been working part-time to support herself in Busan—rough around the edges and deemed unfit for high society.
After returning to the chaebol family, the female lead felt profoundly insecure. Meanwhile, the fake heiress, Song Gayeon, set out to protect her position in both the chaebol family and their elite high school. Time and again, she plotted, joined others in mockery, and ridiculed and ostracized the female lead, until one day, in the grip of depression, the female lead was pushed down the stairs by Gayeon in a scheme—only for the police to rule it a su*cide.
Reborn, Song Eunni opens her eyes to find herself back in the cramped, damp home in Busan. And with her arrival comes a system called Beauty Realization. If she accumulates enough online romantic partners, she will earn an endless stream of fantasy points. These points can enhance her beauty, health, intelligence, and even exchange for wealth.
In this new life, Song Eunni will never allow herself to lose to Song Gayeon again.
She will gain a stunningly natural, otherworldly beauty that others can only dream of, carve out a place for herself in Korea’s most prestigious elite high school, and seize everything that Song Gayeon desires most: the love she craves, her family, her status, and her wealth!
associated_names: 真千金靠網戀對象幻想值提升美貌
真千金靠网恋对象幻想值提升美貌

226974.synopsis:
Go Yu-gyeom, a model student who transfers to a quiet rural school.
And Nam Eun-gang, a delinquent who singles him out and bullies him.
But strangely, the more Eun-gang torments Yu-gyeom, the more he can’t shake the feeling that he’s the one being pulled along by him.
The boys try to understand the world around them, but the world is far too complicated for them to make sense of.
A precarious story about a boy trying to break free from the path laid out for him in a tangled, complicated world, and another boy trying to hold him back.
